posts.hook: Apple guts its $3,499 headset bet just as Anthropic pitches a $2 trillion IPO
posts.caption: apple cuts 200+ jobs off vision pro and siri, anthropic's bankers pitch a $2 trillion ipo, nvidia's avo agent hits a perfect arc-agi-3 score, tiktok pays $400m to settle a child privacy lawsuit. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)
